name: Jumbo_OCR_purchaseOrder_schema_RetailHome
schemaDescription: v7 - Fixed header netAmount/grossAmount descriptions, corrected receiverId, added vendorNo/vendorAdress/deliveryAdress descriptions

headerFields.name: purchaseOrder
headerFields.description:
The Purchase Order number found in the header section of the document, 
labeled as "Purchase Order No". 
Example values: 3200000075, 1000000540
headerFields.label: Purchase Order No

headerFields.name: taxId
headerFields.description:
The Tax Registration Number (TRN) of the company printed on the document. 
Located in the top left section under company info, labeled as "TRN". 
Example value: 100021104300003
headerFields.label: TRN

headerFields.name: netAmount
headerFields.description:
The TOTAL order amount for the entire purchase order (header-level summary value).
Located in the SUMMARY row at the BOTTOM of the item table, in the row labeled 'Total Quantity'.
This is the LAST row of the item table — DO NOT confuse with line item amounts.
For TRADE LOCAL format: extract from the 'Total Amount Excl. VAT' column of the Total Quantity summary row.
For RETAIL format: same 'Total Amount Excl. VAT' column of the Total Quantity summary row.
Example: 14004.09, 6513.47

headerFields.name: grossAmount
headerFields.description:
The TOTAL order amount for the entire purchase order (header-level summary value).
Located in the SUMMARY row at the BOTTOM of the item table, in the row labeled 'Total Quantity'.
This is the LAST row of the item table — DO NOT confuse with line item amounts.
For TRADE LOCAL format: extract from the 'Total Amount Including VAT' column (last column) of the Total Quantity summary row.
For RETAIL format: same last amount column of the Total Quantity summary row.
When VAT=0, this value equals netAmount.
Example: 14004.09, 6513.47

headerFields.name: currencyCode
headerFields.description:
The currency code of the transaction extracted from the 
"Currency" field in the document header. 
Example values: AED, USD
headerFields.label: Currency

headerFields.name: documentDate
headerFields.description:
The date of the Purchase Order, labeled as 
"Purchase Order Date" in the document header. 
Example value: 2026-04-09
headerFields.label: Purchase Order Date

headerFields.name: deliveryDate
headerFields.description:
The expected delivery date if present in the document header.
If not present in header, leave empty.
Do NOT use line item Delivery Date or Valid Till values here.
Example: 2026-04-20
headerFields.label: deliveryDate

headerFields.name: paymentTerms
headerFields.description:
Payment terms of the purchase order extracted from 
the "Payment Terms" field in the header. 
Example values: "Z009 - 30 Days Net", "30 Days Net"
headerFields.label: Payment Terms

headerFields.name: receiverId
headerFields.description:
The reference identifier for the delivery or ordering party.
In TRADE LOCAL format: extract the value of the 'Ref No' field in the header (right side, below Purchase Order Date). Example: 160426NP01
In RETAIL THIRD PARTY format: extract the name following 'Delivery Location :' on page 2. Example: MARYAM
If neither field is present, leave empty.

headerFields.name: quantity
headerFields.description:
The total quantity of all items in the purchase order. 
Extracted from the bottom summary row of the item table, 
labeled as "Total Quantity".
headerFields.label: Total Quantity

headerFields.name: discount
headerFields.description:
The discount amount applied to the order if present. 
If no discount exists in the document, leave empty.

headerFields.name: totalVAT
headerFields.description:
The total VAT amount for the entire order. 
Extracted from the VAT Amount column of the 
bottom summary/total row of the item table.

headerFields.name: vendorNo
headerFields.description:
The 7-digit supplier contact/reference number in the SUPPLIER INFO block on the left side of the document.
Located below the company name and address, in the line starting with 'Tel: +971 4'.
This number appears on EVERY page of the document at the same position.
Example: 3367999
Do NOT confuse with TRN (which has 15 digits).

headerFields.name: vendorAdress
headerFields.description:
The supplier/vendor postal address printed in the SUPPLIER INFO block on the left side.
Starts with 'P.O. BOX' and includes building name, area, city, and country.
May span multiple lines. Combine all address lines into one field.
Example: P.O. BOX 3426, Al Gurg Building, Deira, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

headerFields.name: deliveryAdress
headerFields.description:
The delivery address for the purchase order, found on page 2 under 'Delivery Location'.
Includes street address, P.O. BOX, city, and country.
Example: JRET-Mall Of Emirates-SR, P.O.BOX 99999, Shaikh Zayed Road, Dubai

lineItemFields.name: description
lineItemFields.description:
The product description or name extracted from the 
"Description" column of the line item table.
Only extract from rows that have a valid S.No value.
Ignore summary rows such as "Total Quantity" or "Total" rows.
Example value: "55 Inch MINILED 4K TV"
lineItemFields.label: Description

lineItemFields.name: netAmount
lineItemFields.description:
The line item total amount including VAT,
extracted from the "Total Amount Including VAT" column
(last column) of the line item table.
Only extract from rows with a valid S.No value.
IGNORE the Total summary row at the bottom of the table.
lineItemFields.label: Total Amount Including VAT

lineItemFields.name: quantity
lineItemFields.description:
The numeric quantity value extracted from the "Quantity" column 
of the line item table. 
Valid line items MUST have a numeric quantity value greater than 0. 
Rows without a valid quantity are summary rows and must be ignored.
Example value: 1
lineItemFields.label: Quantity

lineItemFields.name: unitPrice
lineItemFields.description:
The price per single unit extracted from the "Unit Price" column 
of the line item table. 
Only extract from rows that have a valid S.No value. 
EXCLUDE the summary/total row at the bottom of the table 
where "Total" or "Total Quantity" text appears.
Example value: 14656.33
lineItemFields.label: Unit Price

lineItemFields.name: materialNumber
lineItemFields.description:
The product code extracted from the line item table. 
This column may be labeled either "Article Code" or 
"Model Number" depending on the document format.
For Article Code format: extract only the first line 
(product code before the barcode number).
Example: from "K-55XR70 / 4548736160491" extract "K-55XR70"
Only extract from rows that have a valid S.No value.
lineItemFields.label: Model Number / Article Code

lineItemFields.name: itemNumber
lineItemFields.description:
The sequential item number extracted from the "S.No" column 
of the line item table. 
If this field has a value, it is a valid line item row. 
Rows without S.No (such as Total or Total Quantity rows) 
are summary rows and must be completely ignored.
Example values: 00010, 10
lineItemFields.label: S.No

lineItemFields.name: unitOfMeasure
lineItemFields.description:
The unit of measure extracted from the "UOM" column 
of the line item table. 
Example values: EA, PCS, BOX
Only extract from rows that have a valid S.No value.
lineItemFields.label: UOM

lineItemFields.name: grossAmount
lineItemFields.description:
The line item total amount excluding VAT. 
This column may be labeled either "Total Amount Excluding VAT" 
or "Total Amount" depending on the document format.
Only extract from actual item rows with a valid S.No value. 
IGNORE the final Total or Total Quantity summary row 
at the bottom of the table.
lineItemFields.label: Total Amount Excluding VAT

lineItemFields.name: VATValue
lineItemFields.description:
The VAT amount for the specific line item, 
extracted from the "VAT Amount" column of the line item table. 
Only extract from actual item rows with a valid S.No value. 
Ignore the summary row at the bottom.
Example value: 0.00
lineItemFields.label: VAT Amount

lineItemFields.name: DeliveryDate
lineItemFields.description:
The delivery or validity date for the specific line item.
May be labeled "Delivery Date" (Format 1: Model Number docs)
or "Valid Till" (Format 2: Article Code docs).
Only extract from rows with a valid S.No value.
IGNORE summary rows at the bottom.
Example: Apr 20, 2026
lineItemFields.label: Delivery Date

lineItemFields.name: barcode
lineItemFields.description:
The barcode or EAN number extracted from the "Article Code" column. 
This is the second line of the Article Code field, 
appearing after the product code.
Example: from "K-55XR70 / 4548736160491" extract "4548736160491"
Only present in documents with "Article Code" column format.
If the column is labeled "Model Number", leave empty.
lineItemFields.label: Barcode

lineItemFields.name: deliveryLocation
lineItemFields.description:
The delivery location or site for the line item, 
extracted from the "Site" column of the line item table. 
This column only exists in documents with "Article Code" format. 
If the "Site" column does not exist in the document, leave empty.
Example value: JRET-Virtual Supplier
